items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: Aura had a band here. Used to call it Aura's Band, Aura's Brass Band. He was a trombone player.

ctx.x: We used to call him Troste. We used to go, bands used to have were hoistels them days at people's house and they'd invite you. You know, we had plenty of that ourselves. And this fella, we went to a lot of things. I don't know what band he had here. Did he die in California? Did he die in California? Yeah, Aura. Yeah, Aura had a band here. Used to call it Aura's Band, Aura's Brass Band. He was a trombone player. Well, they had a couple of brothers to play music. They come from right up around, somewhere around…
Eh? Piku, you know Piku, huh? Piku. He's right there, over there, Robinson Street.
